semantic_reconciliation.reason: The frozen PWA was initially byte-identical, but its library query returned one row per relation. A canonical content can have multiple relations, so a one-content-one-card result required a focused data-model adaptation rather than preserving the duplicate join.

adaptations.library_card_identity: list_library now joins exactly one deterministic relation per content: active before closed, then newest observation, then relation id. A relation filter selects the matching relation as the card metadata while keeping one content row.
adaptations.feed_grid_detail: The persisted legacy list view is migrated to feed; the PWA exposes Feed and Grid explicitly, and Detail renders every relation attached to the unified content instead of only the first relation.
adaptations.pwa_shell: An internal SVG favicon is linked by HTML, manifest, and service-worker cache so the rendered PWA has no default favicon 404.

defect_reproduction_before_fix.fixture: one generic-web canonical URL captured with manual_save and bookmark

unified_content_relation_observations.meaning: A unified content identity is rendered once in Feed/Grid while every user relation stays visible in Detail and remains filterable.

pwa_render_validation.execution: Existing local Google Chrome controlled through Playwright against a loopback-only temporary API and fixture database; no browser download, user profile, external page, provider, or credential was used.
interaction_contract: Initial Grid renders one canonical content card.
The 时间线 control switches the library class to feed.
Opening the card shows the Detail dialog with manual_save and bookmark relation pills.
Both viewports had no console errors, failed resources, or horizontal overflow.
pwa_render_validation.screenshots: Inspected during the local run, then discarded with the temporary fixture directory; no screenshot or fixture database is retained in the repository.

source_change.product_source_rewrite: No broad rewrite. The only data-model change is one-card-per-canonical-content query selection; PWA changes expose the specified Feed/Grid/Detail behavior and remove the observed icon 404.

scope_exclusions: No real provider account, user content, browser profile, Cookie, password, authentication header, provider network request, Docker image build, Docker service, deployment, cloud action, private-database action, GitHub push, merge, rebase, or new Git worktree action occurred.

The visual validation used only loopback HTTP plus a temporary local fixture database. The explicit temporary directory, screenshots, browser context, and fixture data were moved to the system Trash after validation and are not repository artifacts.
No credential value or credential-bearing URL is present in this evidence.
